2026_02_NYG_LA.headline: Dart’s mobility tests a Rams rush rebuilding its plan without Garrett
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph1: New York travels to Los Angeles after Jaxson Dart paired efficient passing with 54 rushing yards in an opening win, but the Giants have lost cornerback Paulson Adebo to injured reserve. The Rams are trying to rebound from a lopsided opener and must generate pressure without Myles Garrett, who underwent knee surgery. Los Angeles needs disciplined rush lanes against Dart’s improvisation; New York must protect well enough to exploit a Rams defense adjusting its edge rotation.
2026_02_NYG_LA.model_rationale: Dart’s mobility against disciplined rush lanes and the Rams’ ability to manufacture pressure without Garrett should determine whether New York can consistently extend drives and create explosives.
